title: Study plan: Finance, General (CIP 52.0801)

source_refs.version: CIP 2020 to O*NET-SOC 2019 (sha256-pinned; the file states no revision date)

elements: practice scenario tasks with rubrics and reference answer outlines

agree: All 18 crosswalk links for CIP 52.0801 resolve to O*NET 31.0 occupation codes (tests check this).
Entry targets are O*NET Job Zone 4 linked occupations: Financial and Investment Analysts; Credit Analysts; Loan Officers.

Entry targets were changed from the rule output by a documented manual override: Financial and Investment Analysts, the most typical entry role for finance graduates, was missing from the rule output. Budget Analysts was dropped here (it remains a target for Accounting, where budget work is closer to the curriculum). Credit Analysts and Loan Officers are kept.
reject: Not used as entry targets (leadership, faculty, or residual titles): Chief Executives; Chief Sustainability Officers; General and Operations Managers; Financial Managers; Treasurers and Controllers; Investment Fund Managers; Financial Specialists, All Other; Business Teachers, Postsecondary.
improve: Knowledge and skill importance used for the outline is an entry-weighted mean (targets weight 2, other Job Zone-appropriate non-leadership linked roles weight 1); the weights are a DreamCo heuristic, not an O*NET method, and the unweighted all-linked list is shown for comparison.
Course topics in the outline are typical US undergraduate topics written per major, not a specific institution's curriculum.
still_need_test: Practice prompts, rubrics and reference answer outlines are AI-authored and have not been piloted with learners, scored by human graders, or human-reviewed.
Regression evidence compares this build with the previous release (8cc1ce1) on links, targets, task citations and O*NET text leakage; it does not measure learning outcomes.
No sandbox, benchmark or holdout evaluation exists: this box has no independent model API key or human graders, and a self-graded run would not be independent evidence.
DreamCo-original text has not had owner review.

notes: dreamco_analysis is generated by build.py from build facts and the authored review files; it is not a human review.

validation_evidence_ids: only regression evidence (if listed) exists. sandbox and benchmark are empty on purpose; holdout stays empty until the owner grades evidence/holdout_kit; evidence/pytest.txt is a build-integrity run and is not counted.

evidence is append-only: records for earlier versions of this asset stay linked; the ones whose source_reference is this version's integrity_hash are: regression:edu-fg-52.0801:20261002-03, regression:edu-fg-52.0801:20261002-04
perspectives_used has one entry: O*NET and the crosswalk are both official USDOL/ETA sources (closest policy perspective: official_documentation).
